channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Mahatma Gandhi — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-03
item.description: “Prayer is not asking. It is a longing of the soul.” — Mahatma Gandhi

item.title: Andrew Carnegie — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-02
Karl Marx — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-01
item.description: “The philosophers have only interpreted the world, in various ways. The point, however, is to change it.” — Karl Marx

item.title: Rabbi Hillel — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-31
item.description: “If I am not for myself, who will be for me? If I am not for others, what am I? And if not now, when?” — Rabbi Hillel

item.title: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-30
item.description: “If you want to shine like a sun, first burn like a sun.” — A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

item.title: Epictetus — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-29
item.description: “Keep silence for the most part, and speak only when you must, and then briefly.” — Epictetus

item.title: Helen Keller — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-28
item.description: “Walking with a friend in the dark is better than walking alone in the light.” — Helen Keller

item.title: Winston Churchill — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-27
item.description: “Before you can inspire with emotion, you must be swamped with it yourself. Before you can move their tears, your own must flow. To convince them, you must yourself believe.” — Winston Churchill
